premises.clock_factorization: H_(kappa,eta)=kappa*Hhat_eta; finite vacuum and thermodynamic equal-time cylinder state depend on eta,not overall kappa
premises.physical_support: Actual edge-midpoint supports have positive limiting Euclidean separation r; graph steps move midpoints at most physical spacing h
premises.review_boundary: Actual SU2 interaction and Dobrushin clustering are upstream written analytic candidates,not independently certified by this follow-up

conclusions.criterion: If gamma=limsup h*log(B_h)<log(4/3)*liminf(r_h),then separated connected covariance tends to zero
conclusions.plaquette_smear: Osc(Z_h*h^3*sum f_p*(w_p-mean))<=8*abs(Z_h)*h^3*sum abs(f_p); for unit boxes at h=1/N,this is<=48*norm(f)_infinity*abs(Z_h)
conclusions.polynomial_example: Two h^-4-normalized unit-box plaquette smears have budget<=2304*norm(f)*norm(g)*h^-8 and vanishing separated covariance
conclusions.loop_boundary: Osc(normalized SU2 loop trace)<=2*distinct_edge_count; exponential perimeter normalization may leave the covered budget class and requires a new source estimate
